VBO:0201397.summary: Water spaniels include the distinct Irish and American Water Spaniel breeds. The Irish standard describes hunting and retrieving in heavy cover and a traditional wildfowling role; the American was developed to retrieve from small boats as well as work on land.
VBO:0201397.shortDescription: A water-working spaniel category including the distinct Irish and American Water Spaniel breeds.

sources.title: FCI Standard 124: Irish Water Spaniel
sources.evidence: Page 2 utilisation describes hunting and retrieving from heavy cover and traditional choice of wildfowler; classified Group 8 Section 3 Water Dogs. Pages 3–5 describe smooth long muzzle, topknot, curled ears/body and smooth tapering tail.

sources.title: FCI Standard 301: American Water Spaniel
sources.evidence: Page 2 states development in the United States as an all-round hunting dog, retrieving from skiff/canoes and working on ground; classified Group 8 Section 3 Water Dogs.
